errors.description: The geometric-series evaluation is incorrect: the sum of all smaller powers is 2^k-1, not 2^k-2. The required strict inequality and nonvanishing conclusion remain valid after this immediate correction.
errors.quote: the sum $1+2+\cdots+2^{k-1}=2^k-2$ of all smaller powers

parsed.notes: Apart from this arithmetic typo, the argument rigorously proves both matching discrepancy bounds and correctly converts the discrepancy into the stated game value.
